acceptance: A dispatched nightly.yml run on develop shows no failed steps in each leg that is un-quarantined
continue-on-error and the quarantine suffix are removed from those legs, with workflow tests updated
Issues #2568, #2569 and #2570 are closed with run evidence, or each leg that stayed quarantined has its own tracker item
description: Three legs of .github/workflows/nightly.yml are non-blocking: the Windows 'test' legs (#2568), the Windows integration-smoke leg (#2569) and scheduled-workflow-liveness (#2570). After the fixes for all three have merged, dispatch nightly.yml on develop and judge each leg by step results, not job conclusion, because continue-on-error reports a failed job as success. For every leg whose steps all pass, remove continue-on-error and the quarantine suffix from its name, update any workflow tests that assert them, and close its issue with a comment linking the run and the fix. A leg that still fails keeps its quarantine and gets a tracker item with the failing step. Skip the Windows 'test' legs if the coverage decision retires them.
